entries.author: alice
entries.rationale: The UI extractor collapsed both API outcomes onto PageLoaded with no guard, so the two are ambiguous (M-18 determinism). The API distinguishes them: ApiSpecController.getById returns 204 guarded t.isEmpty() and 200 from SpecPresent. This is the API's own condition carried onto the UI branch it invokes (M-5c), not a new claim.

entries.author: alice
entries.rationale: The complement of the 204 branch. Without it the 200 branch is unguarded and always matches, so the pair stays ambiguous. The API models this distinction as a source state (SpecPresent vs Ready); the UI cannot, because the page is loaded before the response is known, so the condition rides on the branch instead.
